officialStores.title: Official stores
officialStores.description: Official store slugs or URLs, e.g. samsung or https://www.mercadolibre.cl/tienda/samsung. Tracks the products shown on the store's storefront. No credentials needed.

items.title: Listings (URLs or IDs)
items.description: Listing URLs or IDs like MLC1234567890. Requires Mercado Libre API credentials (below). Advanced: needs your own Mercado Libre OAuth access; may be blocked (HTTP 403).

sellers.title: Sellers (ID or nickname)
sellers.description: Seller IDs or nicknames, tracked through the official search API. Mercado Libre restricted this endpoint in 2025, so it works only with an API token that still has access. Advanced: needs your own Mercado Libre OAuth access; may be blocked (HTTP 403).

site.title: Site / country
site.description: Default site for slugs and bare IDs. Store URLs override it.

trackDiscount.title: Track discount label
trackDiscount.description: Report changes of the discount badge (e.g. 30% OFF).

trackStock.title: Track stock
trackStock.description: Report available quantity changes (API sources only; storefront pages don't show stock).

trackListings.title: Track new / removed listings
trackListings.description: Report listings that appear or disappear.

trackStatus.title: Track status
trackStatus.description: Report status changes (active, paused, closed, not_found).

minChangePercent.title: Min price change %
minChangePercent.description: Ignore price changes smaller than this percentage (e.g. 5 = only changes of 5% or more). Ignored changes are not charged.

onlyPriceDrops.title: Only price drops
onlyPriceDrops.description: Report price decreases only (increases are ignored and not charged).

outputBaseline.title: Output baseline on first run
outputBaseline.description: On the first run (no previous snapshot) also write every listing as a BASELINE row.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Snapshots are kept in a named key-value store per monitor name. Use different names for different watch lists.

resetBaseline.title: Reset baseline
resetBaseline.description: Ignore the saved snapshot and start over.

mlClientId.title: Mercado Libre app ID (optional)
mlClientId.description: From developers.mercadolibre.com. Needed for listings and sellers.

mlClientSecret.title: Mercado Libre app secret
mlClientSecret.description: Used only to get a token; never logged or stored.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy (e.g. RESIDENTIAL) if store pages get blocked.
